component.name: Tilix
component.summary: A modern tiling terminal emulator written in Rust and GTK4

description.p: Tilix is an advanced GTK4 and Libadwaita tiling terminal emulator designed for Linux. Reimplemented in Rust for safety, reliability, and modern desktop compatibility, Tilix empowers developers and system administrators to arrange multiple terminal sessions in flexible splits, synchronize keystrokes across panes, and summon a top-docked Quake drop-down terminal seamlessly under Wayland.

ul.li: Flexible horizontal and vertical tiling layouts with dynamic ratio adjustment.
Multi-session tab support with automatic tab-bar autohide and cross-window detachment.
Synchronized input broadcasting across terminal panes.
Native Wayland Quake drop-down mode via single-instance D-Bus IPC.
OSC 7 current working directory inheritance on splits and tabs.
Interactive preferences with real-time palette and font reconfiguration.
Native Arch Linux and Flatpak distribution with zero legacy D compiler dependencies.

description.p: Initial stable release of the Rust Tilix rewrite featuring GTK4, Libadwaita, Wayland Quake mode, synchronized typing, and native packaging.
